method: Read-only loopback HTTP checks against a production build: rendered English HTML, JSON-LD, discovery and destination routes; no conversion requests
limitations: Does not measure conversion accuracy, public hosting, search ranking or visual browser behavior.
The raw-path check is intended for a production build; development debug payloads are not supported.
